443:t_1:4.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「...It is a pleasure to meet you, Your Majesty $$ディアナ・ソレル$$.」

443:t_1:6.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I am $$エルーナルーナ・バーンストラウス$$, Supreme Commander of the $$新地球皇国$$'s armed forces.」

443:t_1:7.en:
$$ポゥ$$
(So this woman is... $$サイデリアル$$'s $$ストラウス$$...)

443:t_1:8.en:
$$ハリー$$
(Her bold yet meticulous strategies tore the forces defending both Earths to shreds...)

443:t_1:9.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「Supreme Commander $$バーンストラウス$$...」

443:t_1:10.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Please call me $$エルーナルーナ$$, Your Majesty.」

443:t_1:11.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「Then, $$エルーナルーナ$$... Withdraw your troops from this moon at once.」

443:t_1:12.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I cannot do that. I am acting on the orders of $$アウストラリス$$, Emperor of the Empire.」

443:t_1:13.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「Orders...? An ill-suited word for a bloodthirsty warmonger.」

443:t_1:14.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Those are harsh words...」

443:t_1:15.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「Looking at you, I am reminded of a military man once responsible for this moon's defense.」

443:t_1:16.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「He too moved his troops in the name of duty, but in truth rejoiced that the age to wield his power had come.」

443:t_1:17.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Are you suggesting that I am the same?」

443:t_1:19.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「So you see right through me. You got me, you got me... You've got quite an eye.」

443:t_1:20.en:
$$ハリー$$
「Watch your tongue...! You stand before Her Majesty!」

443:t_1:21.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Do you want to fight, Red Glasses? I... enjoy a good fight in the flesh too.」

443:t_1:22.en:
$$ハリー$$
「If you wish, I will answer your challenge with a duel.」

443:t_1:23.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「Enough, $$ハリー$$. A stray dog barking at you is no reason to lower yourself to its level.」

443:t_1:24.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「You've got some nerve, Queen $$ディアナ$$.」

443:t_1:25.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Well, there's no need to keep up appearances now. I'll just be myself.」

443:t_1:26.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「That would be best. It will make this easier to explain.」

443:t_1:27.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「As for your demand that I leave, the answer's still no.」

443:t_1:28.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「My mission is to capture that lunar facility called 《$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#keyword$$》.」

443:t_1:29.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「So that is your target...」

443:t_1:30.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Apparently, I need the Queen's approval to operate it. ...Will you give it?」

443:t_1:31.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「I need not even answer that.」

443:t_1:33.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「$$アウストラリス$$ is such a pain. If the thing's in his way, he should just destroy it.」

443:t_1:34.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「Is Emperor $$アウストラリス$$ not your master?」

443:t_1:35.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「That's the official story, anyway.」

443:t_1:36.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「He's... surprisingly romantic. He seems to value historical things, like ruins and legacies.」

443:t_1:37.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「So apparently I'm supposed to manage this without bloodshed, however much trouble it takes. He makes it sound so easy.」

443:t_1:38.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「You say that after seizing $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#keyword$$ and 《$$ゲンガナム$$》 by force?」

443:t_1:39.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「If you have a problem with it, you should've fought with everything you had. You've got decent forces here. Why surrender so quickly?」

443:t_1:40.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「That's what I was hoping for. Then I could've had some fun fighting Red Glasses over there.」

443:t_1:41.en:
$$ハリー$$
「A warmonger like you could never understand Her Majesty's heart.」

443:t_1:42.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I'm not that stupid. ...The Queen raised the white flag right away to stop you from making a suicide charge, didn't she?」

443:t_1:44.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I can tell just by looking at you. To protect the Queen, you people here don't give a damn about your own lives.」

443:t_1:45.en:
$$ハリー$$
(She merits the title of Supreme Commander... She is more than a bloodthirsty beast.)

443:t_1:46.en:
$$ディアナ$$
($$エルーナルーナ・バーンストラウス$$... I can feel the terror of an Empire that has her at its command...)

443:t_1:47.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「It's a shame, Queen $$ディアナ$$. Knowing you're more than a coward makes me want to fight you even more.」

443:t_1:49.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「That's not what I mean. Fighting isn't just picking up a gun and shooting.」

443:t_1:50.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Fighting warriors who'd risk their lives to protect you is, in a way, fighting you.」

443:t_1:52.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「So even my most passionate appeal didn't reach you...」

443:t_1:53.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Then let's enjoy watching the $c you trust fight $$ハイアデス$$, led by my right-hand man $$ダバラーン$$.」

443:t_1:55.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Of course. Gathering intelligence is basic etiquette before stepping onto a battlefield.」

443:t_1:56.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Oh... Don't worry. I have no intention whatsoever of using a cheap trick like taking you hostage.」

443:t_1:57.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「$$エルーナルーナ・バーンストラウス$$...」

443:t_1:58.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Besides, Queen $$ディアナ$$ is practically family to $$サイデリアル$$.」

443:t_1:60.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「$$ディアナ・ソレル$$, descendant of the last $$クロノ$$...」

443:t_1:62.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I salute your ancestors, Queen $$ディアナ$$, who tried to revive an Earth that had lost everything.」

443:t_2:4.en:
$$ガロード$$
「...This feels kind of nostalgic...」

443:t_2:5.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「$$ガロード$$, have you and the others been here before?」

443:t_2:6.en:
$$ガロード$$
「We came during the $$多元戦争$$ in $$ＵＣＷ$$.」

443:t_2:7.en:
$$ロラン$$
「That was where we first learned our world was the future of $$ＵＣＷ$$.」

443:t_2:8.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「What exactly was the era called $$黒歴史$$... the worst possible future of $$ＵＣＷ$$?」

443:t_2:10.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I hear a disaster caused civilization to decline in $$ロラン$$'s world. Is that what it refers to?」

443:t_2:11.en:
$$シャア$$
「I will take it from here.」

443:t_2:12.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「$$シャア・アズナブル$$...」

443:t_2:13.en:
$$五飛$$
「Why are you speaking up now?」

443:t_2:14.en:
$$シャア$$
「Because I was the one who set $$黒歴史$$ in motion.」

443:t_2:16.en:
$$シャア$$
「To be precise, it was one of my possible selves.」

443:t_2:17.en:
$$シャア$$
「That version of me fought $$アムロ$$ and the others and dropped $$アクシズ$$ onto Earth.」

443:t_2:18.en:
$$バナージ$$
「The correct history $$フル・フロンタル$$ spoke of...」

443:t_2:19.en:
$$シャア$$
「I don't know whether that was the scene he saw.」

443:t_2:20.en:
$$シャア$$
「But if something had triggered it, I, who fought in the $$多元戦争$$, might have taken that path.」

443:t_2:21.en:
$$レド$$
「$$シャア・アズナブル$$ dropped an asteroid...」
